changelog: Customers no longer see 'Unsupported system - Unsupported software'. Every host-level fix (DISCARD udev rule, USB host-mode overlay, Tailscale state clear) used to run in busybox/alpine scratch images pulled on every boot; Home Assistant Supervisor flags any docker image outside the ecosystem as unsupported software at every full power-on (auto-clears ~1h later, but visible to customers in the meantime). All fixes now run on the Supervisor-managed core image instead (resolved dynamically via 'docker inspect homeassistant'), and both first_boot.sh and reset.sh now remove the busybox/alpine images so neither this card nor any clone can ever trigger the flag again. Verified live on cytech.local: after a full power-on reboot the supervisor shows unsupported: [] and no 'Found unsupported images' entry, with all fixes still applying (DISCARD rule + USB overlay confirmed written via the core image).
